zh_CN: 银河外卖公司 · 主线交付完成
en: Galactic Delivery Corporation · Main Delivery Complete

zh_CN: 进场记录：快速俯冲；维修场警报先于你完成签到。
en: Approach: rapid dive; the yard alarms checked in before you did.

zh_CN: 进场记录：缓慢滑翔；沙海航迹被完整保留。
en: Approach: slow glide; the sand-sea route was fully recorded.

zh_CN: 进场记录：常规进入；速度与货物保护保持平衡。
en: Approach: balanced entry; speed and cargo protection stayed in balance.

zh_CN: 货物结果：核心完好，居民净水泵可按计划启动。
en: Cargo: the core is secure; the settlement water pumps can start on schedule.

zh_CN: 货物结果：核心受损但可修，主线交付仍然成立。
en: Cargo: the core is damaged but repairable; the main delivery still stands.

zh_CN: 着陆结果：平稳接地，交付区无额外损伤。
en: Landing: smooth contact, with no additional delivery-zone damage.

zh_CN: 着陆结果：勉强接地，但收件人已安全接收货物。
en: Landing: rough contact, but the recipient safely accepted the cargo.

zh_CN: 着陆结果：货物已由收件人确认接收。
确定解锁 · 快递站变化
伊娅交给你的旧中继铭牌已送入纪念墙陈列位。
en: The old relay plaque from Iya now has a place on the station memorabilia wall.

zh_CN: 下一步：返回快递站，查看新陈列并和老皮汇合。
en: Next: return to the delivery station, see the new display, and reunite with Lao Pi.

zh_CN: 完成有效交付后才能返回快递站。
en: Complete a valid delivery before returning to the station.

zh_CN: 返航链路暂未响应；结算已经保留，可再次确认返回。
en: The return link did not respond; settlement is retained, so you can try again.

zh_CN: 没有可结算的在途主线订单。
en: There is no active main order to settle.

zh_CN: 请从赤砂星交付流程进入结算。
en: Enter results through the Red Sand delivery flow.

zh_CN: 边境快递站 · 首次值班
和老皮完成入职，接下前往赤砂星的第一单，再确认快递船配置。
en: Complete orientation with Lao Pi, accept the first Red Sand order, then confirm the courier ship loadout.

zh_CN: WASD 移动 · E 互动 · 鼠标或方向键操作界面
en: WASD Move · E Interact · Mouse or arrow keys for menus

zh_CN: 尚无可继续的进度；开始新游戏后会自动保存。
en: No progress is available yet. Starting a new game will create a save.

zh_CN: 主存档不可读；继续游戏将使用上一份有效备份。
en: The primary save is unreadable. Continue will use the last valid backup.

zh_CN: 存档无法读取，原文件已保留；你仍可开始新游戏。
en: The save is unreadable and has been preserved. You can still start a new game.

zh_CN: 检测到旧版存档；继续后将安全迁移到当前格式。
en: An older save was found. Continuing will safely migrate it to the current format.

zh_CN: 无法恢复进度，现有存档未被覆盖；你仍可开始新游戏。
en: Progress could not be restored and the existing save was not overwritten. You can still start a new game.

zh_CN: 暂时无法开始新游戏，请重新启动项目。
en: Unable to start a new game. Please restart the project.

zh_CN: 驾驶舱入口 · 已解锁
纪念品墙 · 旧中继铭牌
墙上的陈列位还空着。老皮说空位能提醒人：这里还会有下一程。
en: The display slots are still empty. Lao Pi says empty spaces are proof there will be another route.

zh_CN: 旧中继铭牌表面有一道不属于公司制式的微光；它现在是这座站完成首单的证明。
en: A faint light outside company specifications moves across the old relay plaque; it now marks the station's first completed delivery.

zh_CN: 驾驶舱未解锁：先接取订单
en: Cockpit locked: accept the order first

zh_CN: 驾驶舱未解锁：先确认飞船配置
en: Cockpit locked: confirm the ship loadout first

zh_CN: 与老皮会合并前往驾驶舱
en: Meet Lao Pi and proceed to the cockpit

zh_CN: 查看已归档的机库入口
空格 / 回车关闭 · 可继续移动
en: Space / Enter to close · movement remains available
Objective: Approach and talk to Lao Pi

zh_CN: 下一步：在订单终端接取赤砂星订单
en: Next: Accept the Red Sand order at the terminal

zh_CN: 下一步：在模块工作台确认飞船配置
en: Next: Confirm the ship loadout at the workbench

zh_CN: 下一步：前往驾驶舱入口与老皮会合
en: Next: Meet Lao Pi at the cockpit entrance

zh_CN: 首单已归档：和老皮聊聊，或查看纪念墙上的旧中继铭牌
en: First delivery archived: talk to Lao Pi or inspect the old relay plaque

zh_CN: 驾驶舱暂未解锁：先在订单终端接取订单。
en: Cockpit locked: accept the order at the terminal first.

zh_CN: 驾驶舱暂未解锁：先在模块工作台确认飞船配置。
en: Cockpit locked: confirm the ship loadout at the workbench first.

zh_CN: 赤砂星 · 深层冷却泵核心 · 老皮同行
en: Red Sand · Deep Cooling Pump Core · Lao Pi Aboard

zh_CN: 冷却泵核心已经装舱，老皮会在副驾驶位与你会合。下一步将进入驾驶舱并确认赤砂星航线。
en: The cooling pump core is secured, and Lao Pi will join you in the copilot seat. Next, enter the cockpit and confirm the Red Sand route.

zh_CN: 边境快递船 · 驾驶舱
悬停仅高亮 · 点击或聚焦后按互动键激活
en: Hover only highlights · Click or focus, then use Interact

zh_CN: 六处设备已通电。选择一处查看当前状态。
en: Six devices are online. Select one to inspect its current state.

zh_CN: 导航阵列已通电，正在等待航线授权。
en: The navigation array is powered and waiting for route authorization.

zh_CN: 航站外缘的星光正从多层观察窗外缓慢后移。
en: Station-edge starlight drifts slowly beyond the layered forward window.

zh_CN: 老皮已经在副驾驶席坐稳，安静看着窗外。
en: Lao Pi is settled into the copilot seat, quietly watching the stars.

zh_CN: 公司终端在线，风险提示等待航线确认。
en: The company terminal is online; risk notices await route confirmation.

zh_CN: 收音机停在边境公共频段，只剩很轻的静电声。
en: The radio rests on the frontier public band with only faint static.

zh_CN: 货舱锁定正常，易损货物状态稳定。
en: The cargo bay is locked and the fragile shipment remains stable.

zh_CN: 选择一处设备以查看操作。
en: Select a device to see its action.

zh_CN: 航线授权：等待站内起飞确认。
en: Route authorization: waiting for station preflight confirmation.

zh_CN: 航线授权：需要先领取订单。
en: Route authorization: accept an order first.

zh_CN: 航线授权：赤砂星航路可用。请确认目的地并出发。
en: Route authorization: Red Sand route available. Confirm destination to depart.

zh_CN: 航线状态：已抵达目标星系，不能重复出发。
en: Route status: target system reached; departure cannot repeat.

zh_CN: 航线授权：当前目的地不可用。
调度状态：没有在途订单
航线风险：%d/5 · 货损会降低报酬；优先保护护盾与货物。
en: Route risk: %d/5 · Cargo damage reduces payout; protect shields and cargo first.

zh_CN: 管理备注：事故将计为“自愿职业成长”。
en: Management note: incidents count as voluntary professional growth.

zh_CN: 公司调度尚未签发航线授权。
en: Company dispatch has not issued route authorization.

zh_CN: 航行状态：正在离开快递站。
en: Travel status: departing the courier station.

zh_CN: 航行状态：边境航路巡航中。
en: Travel status: cruising the frontier route.

zh_CN: 航行状态：正在接近赤砂星系。
en: Travel status: approaching the Red Sand system.

zh_CN: 航行状态：目标星系已抵达。
货物完整度：100%（出舱前读数）
星光沿着舷窗边框缓慢后移。远处没有任何东西急着抵达。
en: Starlight drifts along the window frame. Nothing far away seems in a hurry to arrive.

zh_CN: 快递站的灯火退到窗框之外，星点开始加速后移。
en: The courier station lights slip beyond the frame as the stars begin to accelerate.

zh_CN: 航路稳定下来。群星掠过舷窗，远方一点暖红逐渐清晰。
en: The route steadies. Stars cross the window while a warm red point sharpens ahead.

zh_CN: 赤砂星已经占据前窗一角，大气辉光沿行星边缘亮起。
en: Red Sand fills a corner of the window, atmospheric light glowing along its rim.

zh_CN: 请在导航屏确认当前订单目的地。
en: Confirm the current order destination at Navigation.

zh_CN: 脱离快递站泊位，航向已锁定。
en: Clearing the courier station berth; heading locked.

zh_CN: 维持边境航路，赤砂星信标已捕获。
en: Holding the frontier route; Red Sand beacon acquired.

zh_CN: 即将切入横版飞行：用油门/刹车调速，抬头/低头调整姿态。
en: Side-view flight is next: use throttle/brake for speed and pitch up/down for attitude.

zh_CN: 正在将控制权交给横版飞行段。
en: Handing control to the side-view flight stage.

zh_CN: 首次主线旅行需要完整经历，暂时不能跳过。
en: The first main-route journey must be experienced in full.

zh_CN: 旅行已完成；正式流程将进入横版飞行段。
en: Travel complete; the routed flow will enter side-view flight.

zh_CN: 无法出发：请先领取有效订单。
en: Cannot depart: accept a valid order first.

zh_CN: 无法出发：请先在大厅完成飞船配置与起飞确认。
en: Cannot depart: finish ship loadout and preflight confirmation in the station.

zh_CN: 无法出发：所选目的地不属于当前订单。
en: Cannot depart: the selected destination is not allowed by the current order.

zh_CN: 旅行已经开始，不能重复触发出发。
en: Travel has already started and cannot be triggered again.

zh_CN: 该航线已经完成，不能重复触发出发。
en: This route is already complete and cannot depart again.

zh_CN: 银河外卖公司 · 订单终端
其余航线正在等待公司许可。
en: Other routes are awaiting company authorization.

zh_CN: 当前没有在途订单。确认后主线订单不会被误操作放弃。
en: No order is in transit. Once accepted, this main order cannot be discarded by mistake.

zh_CN: 订单已锁定。下一步：前往模块工作台确认配置。
en: Order locked. Next: confirm the loadout at the module workbench.

zh_CN: 订单数据不完整，已禁止接取；请检查货物、目的地、收件人与客户历史。
en: Order data is incomplete. Acceptance is disabled; check cargo, destination, recipient, and customer history.

zh_CN: 当前剧情条件尚未满足，订单暂不可接取。
en: Story requirements are not yet met; this order cannot be accepted.

zh_CN: 已有一份在途订单；一次只能执行一单。
en: Another order is in transit; only one order can be active.

zh_CN: 订单状态服务不可用，已禁止接取。
en: Order state is unavailable; acceptance is disabled.

zh_CN: 飞船配置 · 出发前检查
唯一在役飞船 · 长期改装平台
en: Sole active ship · long-term upgrade platform

zh_CN: 本次货舱：尚未接取订单
主线必需 / 标准配发
当前可用模块均为公司标准配发，无需购买或刷取。
en: All available modules are standard company issue; no purchase or grinding is required.

zh_CN: 请先在订单终端接取赤砂星主线订单。
en: Accept the Red Sand main order at the order terminal first.

zh_CN: 缺少必需模块：%s。重新安装后才能确认出发。
en: Missing required module: %s. Reinstall it before confirming departure.

zh_CN: 必需配置齐全。激光炮与护盾备用电源均为可选模块，不影响主线出发资格。
en: Required loadout complete. The laser and shield backup power are optional and do not gate departure.

zh_CN: 配置已写入飞船状态。可以前往驾驶舱入口与老皮会合。
en: Loadout saved to ship state. Proceed to the cockpit entrance and meet Lao Pi.

zh_CN: 飞船状态服务不可用，无法确认出发。
en: Ship state is unavailable; departure cannot be confirmed.

zh_CN: 订单模块数据不完整，无法确认出发。
en: Order module data is incomplete; departure cannot be confirmed.

zh_CN: 低水资源的沙漠采掘殖民地；航路包含陨石带、大气雷暴与低空雷达区。
en: A low-water desert mining colony; the route includes an asteroid belt, atmospheric storms, and low-altitude radar zones.

zh_CN: 赤砂星第 7 采掘区冷却补给
en: Cooling Supply for Red Sand Extraction Zone 7

zh_CN: 近期重复订购冷却泵与净水组件。
en: Recently placed repeated orders for cooling pumps and water-purification components.

zh_CN: 两份订单因“工业配额异常”被公司取消。
en: Two orders were cancelled for an “industrial quota anomaly.”

zh_CN: 收货坐标靠近工人居住区，而非公司正式仓库。
en: The delivery coordinates are near worker housing, not an official company depot.

zh_CN: 用于赤砂星第 7 采掘区生产维护的标准冷却设备；强烈碰撞可能损坏核心。
en: Standard cooling equipment for production maintenance in Red Sand Extraction Zone 7; heavy impacts may damage the core.

zh_CN: 客户记录显示，该部件更可能用于工人居住区的冷却与净水系统。
en: Customer records suggest this component is more likely intended for cooling and water systems in the worker settlement.

zh_CN: 降低大气进入阶段的环境压力。
en: Reduces environmental pressure during atmospheric entry.

zh_CN: 仅用于清理明确标记的陨石障碍。
en: Clears explicitly marked asteroid obstacles only.

zh_CN: 护盾未满且未 Boost、未倒车时，自动缓慢恢复护盾。
en: Slowly restores an incomplete shield while not Boosting or reversing.

zh_CN: 同声传译器接通了。要是你听见一点水声，先别担心，通常不是故障。
en: The translator is online. If you hear a little water, do not worry. It is usually not a fault.

zh_CN: 先确认一下：你想按公司流程来，还是先看看设备？
en: First things first: follow company procedure, or inspect the equipment?

zh_CN: 好。公司流程的优点是每一步都有编号，缺点是编号经常比步骤多。
en: Good. Every company step has a number. Unfortunately, there are often more numbers than steps.

zh_CN: 也行。先认清出口和咖啡机，通常比读完员工手册有用。
en: Fair. Finding the exit and coffee machine is usually more useful than finishing the handbook.

zh_CN: 准备好后，我们再看订单终端。慢慢来，宇宙暂时不会下班。
en: When you are ready, we will check the order terminal. Take your time; the universe is not clocking out yet.

zh_CN: 你就是新来的地球人？我是老皮。先别紧张，这座站目前还没塌过。
en: You must be the new human from Earth. I'm Lao Pi. Relax—this station has not collapsed yet.

zh_CN: 同声传译器亮着就行。亮着，我们是在聊天；灭了，我多半只是在对你叹气。
en: As long as the simultaneous translator is lit, we're talking. If it goes dark, I'm probably just sighing at you.

zh_CN: 先在大厅里走几步。公司叫这项“岗位空间熟悉”，我们通常叫别撞墙。
en: Walk around the hall first. The company calls it “workplace spatial familiarization.” We call it not walking into walls.

zh_CN: 不错。地板认得你的工牌，墙也暂时没记住你的脸。
en: Good. The floor recognizes your badge, and the walls have not memorized your face yet.

zh_CN: 现在靠近我，跟我打个招呼。会互动，比背完员工手册实用。
en: Now come over and say hello. Knowing how to interact is more useful than memorizing the employee handbook.

zh_CN: 这就对了。边境站人少，开口说话不用预约。
en: That's it. Border stations are quiet; you don't need an appointment to speak.

zh_CN: 公司把“有效同事沟通”列为必修，附录却比同事还多。
en: The company makes “effective colleague communication” mandatory. The appendix is longer than the staff list.

zh_CN: 最后去看一眼订单终端。先认清它，不用急着接单。
en: Last, take a look at the order terminal. Learn where it is; no need to accept anything yet.

zh_CN: 会走、会问，也找到终端了。第一天已经比维护记录完整。
en: You can walk, ask, and find the terminal. Your first day is already more complete than the maintenance log.

zh_CN: 慢慢来。这里现在不只我一个人值班了。
en: Take your time. I'm not the only one on duty here anymore.

zh_CN: 准备好，我们再看看今天送什么。
en: When you're ready, we'll see what needs delivering today.

zh_CN: 累了就歇会儿。订单不会跑，只会被公司标成“等待员工主动成长”。
en: Rest if you're tired. Orders don't run away; the company just marks them “awaiting proactive employee growth.”

zh_CN: 我在这儿。有事叫我，没事也可以。
en: I'm here. Call me if you need something—or if you don't.

zh_CN: 公司把报酬拆成基础款和货损修正，好像多写一行就能把风险算明白。钱到账就行。
en: The company split the payout into base pay and cargo adjustment, as if one extra line could explain the risk. At least the credits arrived.

zh_CN: 等等……那块旧中继铭牌刚才像是响了一下。也可能是站里的旧线路。先别替它写答案。
en: Wait... that old relay plaque sounded like it answered something. Could be the station wiring. Don't write an answer for it yet.

zh_CN: 挂到纪念墙吧。第一件放上去的东西不必解释一切，只要证明我们真的回来过。
en: Put it on the memorabilia wall. The first thing there does not need to explain everything; it only needs to prove we came back.

zh_CN: 订单接下了。冷却泵核心怕撞，先把防护配置看清。
en: Order accepted. The cooling pump core is impact-sensitive, so check the protective loadout first.

zh_CN: 激光炮不是必需品，不过陨石一般不接受公司流程培训。
en: The laser is optional, but asteroids generally refuse company procedure training.

zh_CN: 终端看完就去工作台。别急，公司把“准备充分”也算作一种延误。
en: Head to the workbench when you're done here. No rush—the company also classifies “being prepared” as a form of delay.

zh_CN: 赤砂星的冷却设备别摔。那边的风不讲人情，公司条款也不讲。
en: Don't drop Red Sand's cooling equipment. The wind has no mercy, and neither do the company terms.

zh_CN: 配置好了就叫我。我跟你一起去。
en: Call me when the loadout is ready. I'm going with you.

zh_CN: 窗外安静吧？公司把这段叫“非生产性航程”，我觉得他们没看过星星。
en: Quiet out there, isn't it? The company calls this “non-productive transit.” I don't think they've looked at the stars.

zh_CN: 别急着按导航。先坐稳，等你想走的时候再叫我。
en: No need to rush the navigation controls. Settle in, and call me when you feel like moving.

zh_CN: 航路稳下来了。引擎只剩低声响，说明我们和货物都还在该在的位置。
en: The route has settled. The engine is down to a low hum, which means we and the cargo are still where we belong.

zh_CN: 你装了激光炮。碰上陨石就用，别朝赤砂星挥手——公司会把那算成主动开拓客户关系。
en: You fitted the asteroid laser. Use it on rocks, not to wave at Red Sand—the company would log that as proactive customer outreach.

zh_CN: 没装激光炮也行。陨石带留了绕行口，慢一点；公司目前还没把谨慎列为设备故障。
en: No laser is fine. The asteroid belt has gaps, so take it slow; the company has not classified caution as equipment failure yet.

zh_CN: 再过一会儿就切到侧视飞行。我会提醒阶段，你照顾速度和姿态；真忙不过来，先保住船和货。
en: Side-view flight comes next. I'll call the stages; you manage speed and attitude. If it gets busy, protect the ship and cargo first.

zh_CN: 边境公共频段。有人报天气，有人找走失的维修机器人，听久了就知道这里还住着人。
en: Frontier public band. Weather reports, missing maintenance robots—listen long enough and you remember people still live out here.

zh_CN: 公司把它归类成“非必要噪声”。所以音量小点，别关。
en: The company classifies it as “non-essential noise.” Keep it low, then. Just don't turn it off.

zh_CN: 冷却泵核心读数很稳。它怕撞，不怕路远。
en: The cooling pump core reads steady. It minds impacts, not distance.

zh_CN: 同声传译接通了。我是伊娅，负责这片维修场。你送来的就是深层冷却泵核心？
en: The translator is connected. I'm Iya, and I maintain this yard. Is that the deep cooling pump core?

zh_CN: 把它接上，聚居地的冷却和净水还能撑过下一个风季。我不需要奇迹，只需要它别在最热的那周停。
en: Once it is connected, the settlement's cooling and water systems can last through the next wind season. I don't need a miracle—just for it not to stop during the hottest week.

zh_CN: 你从云层里扎下来的时候，整座场都在猜你先落地还是警报先烧坏。下次给设备一点预告。
en: When you punched through the clouds, the whole yard was betting on whether you or the alarms would land first. Give the equipment some warning next time.

zh_CN: 你在高空绕了很久。这里很少有人愿意慢下来看看沙海——通常公司只计算抵达分钟数。
en: You stayed high for a long while. Few people slow down to look at the sand sea; the company usually counts only arrival minutes.

zh_CN: 进场很稳。够快，也没让维修场的人把工具箱当掩体。
en: That was a steady approach—fast enough, without making the yard crew use their toolboxes as cover.

zh_CN: 核心外壳和密封都完好。我们今晚就能让第一组净水泵恢复运转。
en: The housing and seals are intact. We can bring the first water-purification bank online tonight.

zh_CN: 密封受过冲击，但还能修。我得先做一圈支撑架，净水泵会晚些启动，不会报废。
en: The seals took a hit, but they can be repaired. I'll brace the unit first; the water pumps will start later, not be lost.

zh_CN: 你带了陨石激光。这里没人反对你清航道，只是公司雷达会把武装货船记得格外清楚。
en: You brought the asteroid laser. No one minds you clearing the route, but company radar remembers armed freighters particularly well.

zh_CN: 你没带炮也穿过了陨石带。少一条武装记录，对这片维修场不算坏事。
en: You crossed the asteroid belt without a gun. One less armed-delivery record is not a bad thing for this yard.

zh_CN: 公司单据写的是“第 7 采掘区生产维护”，可这条管线先供工人住区。前几次冷却和净水订单都被改成“配额异常”；我不知道是谁改的。
en: The company manifest says “Extraction Zone 7 production maintenance,” but this line serves worker housing first. Earlier cooling and water orders were rewritten as “quota anomalies.” I don't know who changed them.

zh_CN: 我先校准核心。你可以在维修场走走，看看那台记录终端；它比公司的订单摘要诚实一点。
en: I'll calibrate the core. Walk around the yard and check the record terminal; it is a little more honest than the company summary.

zh_CN: 每个风季，我都要从三百多片散热栅里刮出矿砂。公司把这项工作登记成“自然清洁循环”。
en: Every wind season I scrape ore sand from more than three hundred cooling fins. The company records the work as a “natural cleaning cycle.”

zh_CN: 我们依赖公司的航线，也得学会在它的表格缝里活着。核心能运转，比谁在单据上赢了更重要。
en: We depend on company routes, and we learn to live between the lines of their forms. Getting the core running matters more than winning the paperwork.

zh_CN: 赤砂星那边等它的，不只是仓库编号。平稳送到就行，剩下的到了再看。
en: More than a warehouse number is waiting for it on Red Sand. Deliver it smoothly; we'll see the rest when we arrive.

en: Stay in atmosphere with Limited gravity assist; climb, then hold W + Down + Shift until the dive is clearly fast.

zh_CN: 俯冲后松开 Boost，按 S + ↑，观察能否在撞地前明显收住下降。
en: After the dive, release Boost and hold S + Up; see whether the descent can be arrested before impact.

zh_CN: 先低速擦碰，再高速撞击；观察自动重试，并试一次 R 立即重试。

zh_CN: 按 L 装载激光；短按 F 或鼠标左键验证短光柱，再按住持续击碎小型和大型陨石。

zh_CN: 侧风会持续推移飞船；看见紫白预警柱后立即离开标记区。

en: Low altitude is dangerous: stay at or above 300 m. Climb immediately if scanning begins.

zh_CN: 被电磁暴雪覆盖的冰封星球；地下档案文明把记忆保存视为公共基础设施。
en: An icebound planet under electromagnetic blizzards, where an underground archive civilization treats memory preservation as public infrastructure.

zh_CN: 城市与航路生长在巨树树冠之间；运输窗口受孢子、生物迁徙和生态关系影响。
en: Cities and routes grow among giant canopies, with transport windows shaped by spores, migrations, and ecological ties.

zh_CN: 岛屿城邦依靠天气塔维持航路；横风、潮汐与控制权共同决定公共安全。
en: Island city-states rely on weather towers for safe routes, while crosswinds, tides, and control rights shape public safety.

zh_CN: 提供进入白噪星电磁暴雪航路所需的屏蔽能力；具体效果由后续关卡任务实现。
en: Provides the shielding capability required for White Noise electromagnetic routes; route effects arrive in a later task.

zh_CN: 降低货物信号吸引穹林生物的风险，但不会完全消除生态压力。
en: Reduces the risk of cargo signals attracting Canopy wildlife without removing ecological pressure.

zh_CN: 降低群潮星横风扰动，不自动修正路线或替代玩家判断。
en: Reduces Tidal crosswind disturbance without steering the route or replacing player judgment.

zh_CN: 穹林树冠诊疗点工作人员
用于设备兼容性复核的非标准屏蔽补件；强烈碰撞可能破坏层间结构。
en: Nonstandard shielding parts for an equipment compatibility review; heavy impact may damage the layered structure.

zh_CN: 材料纹路依据旧中继铭牌制作，实际用于改造玩家飞船的高压电防护。
en: The pattern follows the old relay plaque and is actually intended to retrofit the courier ship against high-voltage interference.

zh_CN: 恢复档案服务的标准核心组件；需避免强烈冲击与无屏蔽电磁暴露。
en: A standard core component for restoring archive service; protect it from heavy impact and unshielded electromagnetic exposure.

zh_CN: 组件不仅修复索引，也可能决定公司是否获得档案层批量访问接口。
en: The component repairs an index but may also determine whether the company receives bulk archive access.

zh_CN: 标准生态研究样本；需控制冲击并隔离外泄信号。
en: A standard ecological research sample requiring controlled impact and isolated emissions.

zh_CN: 样本关系到幼林病害隔离和迁徙窗口，其气味与信号会吸引本地生物。
en: The sample affects juvenile-grove disease isolation and migration windows, and its scent and signals attract local wildlife.

zh_CN: 恢复跨城邦天气服务的标准控制组件；需避免盐雾放电与剧烈撞击。
en: A standard control component for restoring inter-city weather service; protect it from salt-spray discharge and heavy impact.

zh_CN: 组件的授权模式会决定谁能控制塔网、航路数据和天气窗口。
en: Its authorization mode determines who controls the tower network, route data, and weather windows.

zh_CN: 因授权记录不完整而退回的私人档案容器；外壳抗冲击能力有限。
en: A private archive container returned for incomplete authorization records, with limited impact protection.

zh_CN: 持有人只要求归还，不希望公司为家庭记录建立商业索引。
en: The owner asks only for its return and does not want a commercial index built for the family record.

zh_CN: 供树冠诊疗点使用的生态稳定剂；必须在指定接收环完成低空投放。
en: An ecological stabilizer for a canopy clinic, to be delivered through its designated low-altitude receiving ring.

zh_CN: 货物用于处理孢子季呼吸问题，其信号会轻度吸引迁徙生物。
en: The cargo treats spore-season respiratory problems, while its signal mildly attracts migrating wildlife.

zh_CN: 用于恢复普通客运与渔业航标的耐候电池组。
en: Weatherproof cells for restoring navigation beacons used by civilian ferries and fishing routes.

zh_CN: 维护队的补给长期排在天气塔核心之后；下一段风墙前需要完成交付。
en: The maintenance crew's supplies have long ranked below tower cores, and delivery is needed before the next wind wall.
A New Shell for the Old Plaque

zh_CN: 伊娅持续维护首单涉及的居民冷却与净水管线。
en: Iya continues maintaining the residential cooling and water lines from the first delivery.

zh_CN: 旧中继铭牌的纹路与公司现行设备标准不一致。
en: The old relay plaque's pattern does not match current company equipment standards.

zh_CN: 公司将本次改装登记为设备兼容性复核。
en: The company has filed this retrofit as an equipment compatibility review.

zh_CN: 档案层的一组关键索引在电磁暴雪后失效。
en: A critical archive index failed after an electromagnetic blizzard.

zh_CN: 当地维护者要求恢复服务时保留最小访问原则。
en: Local maintainers require minimum-access rules during restoration.

zh_CN: 公司希望把修复接口并入跨文明档案服务。
en: The company wants the repair interface folded into its inter-civilization archive service.
A Strange Scent in Migration Season
